category_title: Five-year-old students exhibiting school-related frustration and challenging peer interactions
scenario_title: Morning arrival and transition into classroom activities
minimal_context: Patrick is arriving at the classroom in the morning and needs to transition into a classroom activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning. It is time to come into the classroom and pick an activity to do while the other children are working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: School is dumb. I want to go home.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am sure we can find something you might like to do here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am upset I could not bring my Power Rangers to school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have interesting materials in the classroom you can interact with instead.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Kicks the furniture in frustration) No! I want to go home!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Good morning. It is time to come into the classroom and pick an activity to do while the other children are working.

STUDENT: School is dumb. I want to go home.

TUTOR: I am sure we can find something you might like to do here.

STUDENT: I am upset I could not bring my Power Rangers to school.

TUTOR: We have interesting materials in the classroom you can interact with instead.

STUDENT: (Kicks the furniture in frustration) No! I want to go home!

task.content: Transitioning into the classroom at the start of the school day and engaging in a classroom activity.

context.environment: Classroom during morning drop-off and arrival
context.materials: Classroom furniture, interesting materials in the classroom
context.social_setting: Mother bringing him to the classroom, other children working, teacher available for conversation
context.time_context: Morning arrival before the project began and throughout the year

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When his mother brought him to the classroom and he realized he could not bring his Power Rangers to school
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Displayed anger and irritation, kicked the furniture in frustration, and told the teachers he wanted to go home
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling upset he could not bring his Power Rangers to school

behavior_patterns.condition: During interactions with his peers in the classroom
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Vocalized his frustration and impatience with the members of the group, leaving classmates confused and startled
